title: UPS earnings: $1.45 a share, matching expectations
主要内容: United Parcel Service (UPS) raised its full-year forecast for 2017, with third-quarter revenue increasing by 7% compared to the prior year. However, operating profits remained virtually unchanged at $2 billion. UPS plans to charge extra during peak shipping weeks in November and December. The company also increased its bottom earnings guidance for the full 2017 year to a range of $5.85 to $6.10 per share. UPS shares fell 0.7% following Amazon's announcement of its own delivery business, which accounts for about 10% of UPS revenue. UPS stock has underperformed the market and its competitors in the logistics industry.
